episode: Complete Bathroom Remodel, Sugar House Bungalow

project_context.summary: The source bathroom remodel contains strong homeowner problem and solution content that translates naturally into short form vertical video. These two Shorts pull from the segments where Mike explains why a small bathroom feels cramped and how the layout was reworked to make it functional.
project_context.segment_choice: Short 1 comes from 0:46 to 1:12, where the cramped layout, the two conflicting doors, and the undersized vanity are all visible in one run of footage. Short 2 comes from 1:27 to 2:03, where the layout logic is laid out step by step, the built-in, the toilet nook, the closed off doorway, and the turned vanity.
project_context.publish_order: Short 1 publishes first as the homeowner problem hook, Short 2 second as the contractor solution proof. Together they form a mini funnel from pain point to authority.
notes: Mike's AI voice avatar carries all narration in both Shorts, re-recorded for tighter pacing and search friendly language, over the original bathroom footage.
Scenes marked in Editor notes as needing a confirmed range have no timestamp in the source handoff and get one during frame analysis.

shorts.full_vo:
Here is how we made this TINY bathroom actually work. FIRST, we removed the old BUILT-IN so we could gain some usable space.

Then we created a NOOK for the toilet, which got it out of the main traffic path! We also CLOSED OFF one doorway so the bathroom door could swing the right way.

After that, we TURNED the vanity, so the room had a lot more function and better flow! Same bathroom footprint...just a much SMARTER layout.

Watch the full BEFORE and after!

production_notes: Captions are bold white with a black outline, large enough to read on mobile, always burned in.
Hook text sits in the upper third, supporting captions in the lower third.
Fast cuts, no dead air, the hook must land within 2 seconds.
Mike's AI voice avatar carries all narration in both Shorts, with a tiny pause between sentences so cuts and punch-ins have room.
Original ambient audio stays very low under the VO for texture.
Optional low volume music bed, it must not compete with the VO.
Every cut plays over pre-demo walkthrough, progress state, or final reveal footage. No footage of demo or installation happening, and no workers on camera.
Simple text CTA end frame, no traditional long end cards on Shorts.
Publish order is Short 1 first, then Short 2, problem hook into solution proof.
